title: Read-only account email on profile
summary: Signed-in public accounts can see their login email on Profile as read-only, next to the password block, so they know where notifications and password-reset mail go.
changes: Show the signed-in account email on Profile as read-only, next to the password block.
Explain that notifications and password-reset mail go to that address; do not offer an email-change form.
Keep directory and Cloudron password management in Cloudron; staff continue to see directory email on the staff profile.
version_rationale: Minor release: adds a read-only account email on Profile without introducing an email-change flow.
validation: PHPUnit ProfileAccountEmailTest covers local public visibility next to the password block, directory public email without a password form, staff read-only email, and profile update ignoring a forged email.
Related public profile tests remain green. No impersonation control is present, and email cannot be changed from Profile.
Ran php artisan myapes:changelog-validate against the signed-in local public password-change parent branch for this stacked change.
known_limitations: Account email cannot be changed in MyAPES Account. Live production verification remains a separate change. Directory and Cloudron passwords continue to be managed in Cloudron.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Account email addresses are unchanged by this release.
provenance: Defined by the read-only profile email task for MyAPES Account issue #148 under parent #147 and epic #158 and pull request #163.
